paragraphs: Verkada sells cloud-managed physical security systems that customers around the world use to operate safer, smarter buildings. The line covers cameras, alarms, and unified cloud physical security software with remote access and AI analytics. Customers control an entire physical security operation from Verkada Command.

The architecture eliminates NVRs and servers by blending the reliability of on-prem with the scalability of the cloud. Onboard camera storage options run 30, 60, 90, 120, or 365 days. Cameras use only 20-50 Kbps of upload bandwidth while recording continuously, even during internet outages.

More than 30,000 organizations worldwide use Verkada, from small and midsize businesses to Fortune 500 leaders. Customer stories include the City of Los Angeles, which uses Verkada to unify physical security and improve public safety. Another story covers the Winston-Salem Police Department, whose real-time crime center solves homicides with LPR and Verkada integrations. A story from Parkersburg, West Virginia describes local government, law enforcement and IT teams keeping citizens safe.
